## Back

Landed from Delhi on Wednesday 22 Oct, KL872, 06:05 at Schiphol. Two weeks in Rajasthan with Noor. The trip diary is in Hindi, because I promised my teacher Meenakshi I'd write every day: [[यात्रा डायरी]].

## Jet lag

Worse coming west than going east, which is the wrong way round compared to what people say. Did the morning light thing from [[Jet lag strategy]], walked to work in the dark at 07:30 to catch sunrise on the Amstel. Thursday I was useless after 15:00. Friday fine. Clocks went back last night, so today is a weird extra-hour Sunday.

## Work catch-up

- 412 unread emails, read 60, archived the rest
- Waalhaven date slipped to January, which Jens had already told me would happen
- FreightTech is in 11 days, slides 70% done, dry run on Thursday. Still need Ute's permission for the gate photo, see [[Conference talk proposal]]

- Noor and I are already planning next year. She says Kerala.
